verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains detailed documentation of the skills' features and one ADR noting acceptance into Claude Code's marketplace, but there is no evidence of the repository's own release cadence, issue triage practices, or accepted external contributions/PRs. Community comments are skeptical/critical about the skills' design philosophy but do not address maintenance activity either way. Missing for 10: recent commit/release history, evidence of issues being triaged on the repo itself, evidence of community PRs being merged.
